name: MonarchAiImageGeneration
title: AiImageGeneration
wrapsNative: LazyVGrid(columns: [GridItem(.adaptive(minimum:))]) of AsyncImage or Image slots, ProgressView with .monarchLinear, MonarchTextField per image, Buttons with MonarchButtonStyle
summary: Images generated by AI as a grid of variations: pulsing placeholders while generating, blurred previews while refining, then each image with a required alt text field and "Use image" and "More like this" actions.
whenToUse: Wherever people generate images with AI and pick one to use, for example a cover image, an illustration or a social post.
whenNotToUse: For images the person uploads use a file upload. For a gallery of existing images use a grid of images with a lightbox (see lightbox).
api: MonarchAiImageGeneration.init(images: Binding<[MonarchAiGeneratedImage]>, status: MonarchAiImageGenerationStatus, progress: Double? = nil, selection: Binding<String?>? = nil, error: String? = nil, labels: MonarchAiImageGenerationLabels = MonarchAiImageGenerationLabels(), onVariations: (@MainActor (String) -> Void)? = nil, onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil)
MonarchAiGeneratedImage.init(id: String, url: URL?, alt: String = "")
MonarchAiGeneratedImage.init(id: String, image: Image?, alt: String = "")
enum MonarchAiImageGenerationStatus { case pending, progressive, done, error }

options.name: images
options.description: The images, or their slots while generating, each with an id, a URL or an Image, and its alt text. The alt fields write back to alt.

options.name: status
options.description: pending: placeholders. progressive: previews refining. done: final images with fields and actions. error: the message, with retry when onRetry is set.

options.name: progress
options.description: Overall progress from 0 to 1, shown as a percentage and a bar while generating.

options.name: selection
options.description: The id of the chosen image. Passing it adds "Use image" to each finished image.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replaces any built-in string; position-based strings are closures.

options.name: onVariations
options.description: Adds "More like this" to each finished image; gets its id.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Adds a retry button in the error state.

states.name: pending
states.description: "Generating images…" with the percentage and a bar when progress is known; slots pulse with the assistant subtle tint; alt fields are disabled.

states.name: progressive
states.description: "Refining images…"; previews are shown blurred; empty alt fields show their error.

states.name: done
states.description: "n images generated"; images are sharp, with their alt fields and actions. Completion is announced.

states.name: error
states.description: A danger notice with the message, or MonarchInlineErrorRetry when onRetry is set.

states.name: selected
states.description: The chosen image has a 2-point assistant ring, a "Selected" mark and a primary "Use image" button.

states.name: unavailable
states.description: A slot without a loadable source after generation shows "Preview unavailable".

appearance: Slots are square with the muted background and a subtle border; the chosen image has an assistant (ai) solid ring and a solid mark. The status line is muted caption text; the progress bar is the Monarch linear style. The high-contrast themes resolve the same roles to stronger colours.
platformNotes: The web filters unsafe src values; iOS loads only http, https and file URLs, or an Image the app passes. onSelect becomes a selection binding and onAltChange the images binding. The web shows previews refining with a soft filter; iOS blurs them. Columns are at least 160 points at the default text size and widen with Dynamic Type, so large text gives one column. Android uses the same names.
accessibility: The group is a container named "AI generated images".
The status line is text; the progress bar is hidden because the line carries the percentage.
Completion is announced once, on the change into done.
Each image is read by its alt text with the image trait, or "Generated image n" while the alt text is empty.
Each alt field is a MonarchTextField with its own label ("Alt text for image n") and error text.

"Use image" and "More like this" are named with the image's position; "Use image" has the selected trait on the chosen image, which is also marked by a ring and a "Selected" label, not by colour alone.
Placeholders stop pulsing under Reduce Motion.
edgeCases: Ids must be unique; they identify the grid cells.
Whitespace-only alt text counts as empty.
Progress outside 0...1 is clamped; a non-finite value is ignored.
Images may stay listed in the error state; they keep their slots.
